name: Portage
observation_method: Sequential connected-GitHub inventory and bounded default-history/source reads; selected fields transcribed, not a raw API export.
sampled_commit_scope: Latest default-history item returned at this repository read; not all branches or local state and not an atomic end-of-audit head.
movement: Recent history merges an upstream-sync branch and commits upstream-synced evaluation result timestamps.
concerns: Imported or updated timestamps are not receipts of newly executed owned evaluations.
A successful merge does not establish fork-specific adapter and scorer behavior.

next_actions.title: Reconcile exact owned upstream delta
next_actions.work: Record upstream source/revision, local patches, imported results and current build.
next_actions.acceptance: Each result has producer/source provenance; imported evidence is not represented as a new local run.

next_actions.title: Run matched positive/negative tasks
next_actions.work: Use identical real tasks on the owned fork and upstream; inject timeout, missing tool, incorrect answer and cleanup interruption.
next_actions.acceptance: Trustworthy result classification and retained artifacts; no required oracle silently skipped.

next_actions.title: Qualify install and shared consumers
next_actions.work: Install the fork cleanly; exercise PhenoLab/current consumer interfaces, cancellation, storage/cleanup and resource limits.
next_actions.acceptance: Consumer contract remains compatible after upstream sync with measured benefit or justified patch value.

ecosystem_contract: Portage owns runner behavior, PhenoLab owns experiments, shared adapters belong only in the accepted authoritative package home.
parent_acceptance: The actual fork executes, scores and preserves a bounded evaluation faithfully and reproducibly.
scope_missing: actual chat receipts and read acknowledgement
